@Test
public void testTilde() {
    final String src = "==Willkommen zum WikiWizardScript
" + "~~ sdfsdf
" + "
" + "now what happens?
" + "
" + "- nothing I hope
" + "- maybe something
" + "- we will soon see!
" + "
" + "== and this is a big title =================
" + "
" + "What can we put here?
" + "
" + "{{Web2.png}}";
    final String target = "!!!Willkommen zum WikiWizardScript
" + "~~ sdfsdf
" + "
now what happens?
" + "
* nothing I hope
" + "* maybe something
" + "* we will soon see!
" + "
!!! and this is a big title ===============
" + "
What can we put here?
" + "
[{Image src='Web2.png'}]";
    Assertions.assertEquals(target, translate(src));
}
